content.short: Mesmerizing, fully on-chain, code-based animations, representing abilities in a future web based RPG!
content.description: Wizard Spellz are a collection of 15,555 completely uniquely generated CSS animations that live entirely on Cardano. The code is fully on-chain so your NFT will load instantly, and always work even when IPFS doesn't. Each Wizard Spell is comprised of 7 traits: Core, Element(s), Range, Speed, Duration, Potency, Turbulence, and Attribute, with many options varying in rarity. The Spellz represent abilities in the upcoming browser RPG, Wizard Crypt. The game will be centered around exploration and party building.
content.meta: Find out about Wizard Crypt (NFT) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
